items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: I used to play with Punch... And I played at Punch in the orchestra

ctx.x: Well, you were talking about, uh, another band you heard, who was that?
No, I used to play with Punch. Oh, yeah, Punch. Kid Punch. I played at Lee Collins on parade, you know. And I played at Punch in the orchestra, you know.
Do you remember who was in Punch's band then?
